name: button
title: Button
author: Aeri UI
description: A semantic Button with restrained press feedback.
docs:
## Purpose

Use Button for a discrete action. It keeps the Consumer Theme by using shadcn semantic tokens and gives a short press acknowledgement without a motion runtime.

## Installation

Install with the Aeri UI registry command shown on this Item Page. Preview installations configure the Aeri UI registry URL in `components.json`.

## API and anatomy

`Button` accepts Base UI Button props and `className`. It forwards its ref and its anatomy is one Base UI Button primitive. It does not add variants or animation controls.

## Dependencies and client boundary

`@base-ui/react` is Button's only runtime dependency. Button reaches Base UI's client boundary, so using it adds that client component to a Consumer Project. The Catalog Live Preview adds further client state only to expose controls.

## Accessibility

The underlying Base UI Button preserves native button semantics, keyboard activation, focus visibility, disabled behavior, and form support.

## Motion and performance

Press feedback is a CSS transform and transition. It respects `prefers-reduced-motion` and adds no animation dependency or idle work.

## Customization

Override semantic colors, typography, and radius through the Consumer Theme. Use `className` for local layout changes. The source does not change global styles.

## Compatibility

Button supports Next.js 16 App Router Consumer Projects using React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn, and Base UI. It is responsive and inherits RTL direction from its Consumer Project.
